 versus

Responde
 Through: Respondent No.2 in person.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
Learned counsel for petitioner has joined the proceedings through video-conferencing and respondent No.2 is present in person.
2. On the basis of the complaint filed by revisionist herein, one FIR was registered for commission of offence under Section 498A/406 IPC.

3. Fact, however, remains that the abovesaid case resulted in acquittal and, when appeal was filed before the learned Court of Sessions, such appeal has also been dismissed and it is in the abovesaid backdrop, the present revision petition has been filed.
4. Since there is another time fixed matter today, it will not be possible to hear final arguments in the present petition.

5. List on 07.05.2026 at 3:30 pm for final arguments.
MANOJ JAIN, J MARCH 25, 2026/st/pb
